function: Jointly learns UE channel-adaptive uplink pilots (analog CSI feedback) and BS downlink precoders for SU-MIMO and MU-MIMO, with implicit CSI acquisition in TDD (pp. 1, 4).
system: TDD DL SU-MIMO and MU-MIMO (K=4), BS 32 antennas, UE 4 antennas, narrowband, 7 GHz, 20 MHz, 30 kHz subcarrier spacing, no RIS (pp. 8, 10).
method: FC-layer DNNs at UE (pilot generator) and BS (naive or optimal-structure precoder), trained end-to-end unsupervised on negative sum-rate with Adam; fine-tuning tested (pp. 5, 7-8, 14).
data_channel: Nokia private 7 GHz ray-tracing dataset (3GPP TR 38.901 UMa) and QuaDRiGa 7 GHz dataset; 18,000 UEs train, 2,000 UEs test (pp. 3, 8).
test_conditions: Trained and tested per dataset on held-out UEs, SNR sweeps; Nokia-pretrained model tested on QuaDRiGa data, without and with fine-tuning on 5,000 or 10,000 samples (pp. 8, 14).
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE and RLS estimation with Walsh or SVD pilots plus SVD beamforming; WMMSE and block diagonalization; full-CSI bounds. Learned: none external; naive DNN is own variant (pp. 9-11).
metrics: DL channel capacity (SU-MIMO) and sum-rate (MU-MIMO) in bps/Hz versus DL SNR, UL SNR, probing beams, fine-tuning; beam patterns; FLOPs (pp. 9-14).
complexity: Table III gives FLOPs in Big-O for pilots, estimators, WMMSE, BD, and the proposed DNNs; DNN order is quadratic, O(NinNout) per FC layer (pp. 13-14).
q1_support: p. 3: "a separate 7 GHz dataset generated by using the QuaDRiGa simulator [31]" and Nokia ray tracing "compliant with the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) specification TR 38.901"; p. 8: Table I, UMa in TR 38.901.
q2_support: p. 14: "Initially trained on Nokia data", then "pretrained models without fine-tuning, and models fine-tuned with 5,000 and 10,000 QuaDRiGa samples".
q3_support: p. 9: "Therefore, we did not consider DNN-based precoding approaches as benchmarks." Baselines are non-learned; the naive DNN is one of "our two proposed methods" (p. 10, legend "Naive DNN (Proposed)") and the SVD-pilot DNN is an ablation (p. 12).
q4_support: p. 14: "Table III presents the FLOPs of the proposed DNNs compared to other methods"; Table III (p. 13) lists the Big-O FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 3: "a private 7 GHz band dataset provided by Nokia Bell Labs"; the QuaDRiGa dataset is self-generated (p. 8); the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: Included, area 3 rather than 2: the pilot and the precoder are trained on the sum-rate and the paper says CSI acquisition serves precoding, not channel estimation (p. 3). q1 rests on QuaDRiGa and TR 38.901 UMa; the Nokia set is private ray tracing. q3=0: no earlier learned method is compared; the naive DNN is the authors' own structure-free variant (p. 10). q5=0: Nokia data is private.
